name: hyperbolic_reef
theme: a night coral reef read as a ruffle of ruffles and back — down onto one frilled coral head whose every plate margin carries seven smaller frills, into the black pleat between two of them where the walls ruffle again over rows of polyp cups, out to the beaded tentacle fans, which open out into the torn filament sheets of a supernova remnant, and the return falls down one filament through a white star and its dark ocean world to the moonlit reef

registers.name: reef_night
registers.palette: ink-black water, silver-white light shafts, pink glints
registers.scene: a night coral reef seen from the open sand a little way off, thin shafts of moonlight coming down through the black water onto low mounded coral heads spread across the reef floor, ruffled coral plates standing among them in pink and acid green, pale sand channels running between the mounds, fine motes hanging lit in each shaft, black water overhead, empty, no one present

registers.name: coral_head
registers.palette: pink with acid-green rims on black
registers.scene: one ruffled coral head standing clear of the sand, stacked plates of pink coral folded over one another, every plate margin carrying seven smaller frills of its own and each of those crowded with smaller frills again, a thin acid-green line of light along every rim, deep black pleats folding down between the plates, dark water on all sides

registers.name: pleat_walls
registers.palette: pale green-ivory walls and ink-black depth
registers.scene: the black cleft between two ruffled coral margins, the pale walls on either side themselves ruffled into smaller frills that crowd toward a glowing green edge above, rows of round polyp cups set into every ruffle face, fine ivory ridges running between the cups, beaded tentacle fans standing open over the cups, cold green light seeping down from the rim, ink-black depth below

registers.name: bead_fans
registers.palette: hot-pink filaments and green beads on black
registers.scene: ranked fans of fine coral tentacles standing in black water, every strand a slender hot-pink filament strung with small round beads of green light, the fans layered in torn ranked sheets one behind another, black gaps running through them in every direction, a faint pink glow along every filament

registers.name: remnant_lace
registers.palette: pink and acid green on black sky
registers.scene: torn sheets of glowing filament hung across a black sky, long ranked strands of pink and acid-green light folded over one another, ragged bright edges where the sheets curl over, black sky showing through every gap, cold stars scattered far behind them

registers.name: white_star
registers.palette: white-hot core, pink and green far off, black
registers.scene: a white star burning in an open clearing of the torn filament sheets, its light thrown out in fine spikes, ranked curtains of pink and acid-green filament standing far off on either side, a flat disk of glowing debris set around the star, one dark blue world sitting out along the disk, cold stars scattered across the black
registers.loop_target: a white star burning in an open clearing of ranked pink and acid-green filament curtains

registers.name: night_sea
registers.scene: a black night sea seen from far above, a broken silver-white path of moonlight lying across the water, pale reef rings and shallow lagoons strewn through the dark ocean, thin ribbons of cloud lying over them, a faint green shimmer in the shallowest water, the dark curve of the horizon along the top

music_theme: a moonlit night reef opening into a supernova's torn lace — slow sub-bass swells under glassy bell tones and a wide airy pad, a bright struck hit where the beaded coral fans open out into the filament sheets, settling back into soft water-lapping percussion
